newsitem.title: USA: Mead completes Boise mill purchase.
newsitem.headline: Mead completes Boise mill purchase.

text.p: The Mead Corp said on Friday that it completed its previously announced acquisition of an integrated paper mill in Maine from Boise Cascade Corp for about $640 million in cash.

"We are delighted the transaction has closed quickly and smoothly and we intend to move quickly to complete the integration of the Rumford mill into Mead's coated paper system," said Steven Mason, Mead chairman and chief executive officer.
Mason said the mill complemented the two existing coated paper mills and added to the company's high value specialty paper business.
